title: IntegrityReport::is_healthy rustdoc claims canonicalization and digest checks that verify_all does not perform
outcome: IntegrityReport::is_healthy rustdoc claims canonicalization and digest checks that verify_all does not perform
acceptance: The rustdoc of IntegrityReport::is_healthy (src/storage/mod.rs) describes healthy as the absence of integrity findings, without claiming canonicalization or digest checks that verify_all does not perform

completion.summary: The IntegrityReport::is_healthy rustdoc now says only that every finding list in the report is empty, and that verification parses stored record ids but never re-derives one from stored bytes. It no longer claims canonicalization or digest checks that verify_all does not perform. A round-1 Medium (wording that denied the fingerprints verify_all does recompute) was fixed and reviewed again. Landed in ce32318 with w-e736c419c503: full gate test-296baf89 passed, the round-2 Codex+Claude pair was clean, and the evaluation passed 1/1 (ce647c5a…).
